Name: Refined Abigail and Emily Portraits
Author: Chrysanthe
Description:
[b][size=6][center]Refined [color=#674ea7]Abigail,[/color] [color=#3c78d8]Emily, [/color][color=#efefef]and [/color][color=#a64d79]Maru[/color][color=#1155cc] [/color]Portraits[/center][/size][/b]My Refined portraits have substantial edits made to vanilla portraits (that I think) improve them.
In Abigail's case, I wanted to make her hair look a bit more normal and get rid of the octopus parts in there. Her face has been slimmed a bit and the nose changed. Her outfit looks a bit weird so I smoothed it out and gave her a whole new inner tshirt. More of her arms are also showing now. I think she looks more mature too.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/jYoPdeE.png[/img]

[b]Emily [/b]got a whole hair makeover since it was a mess and looked nothing like her sprite. Her outfit was also changed to a sleeveless red dress, The shadows on her face have been toned down. I really like what I did with her, and I hope you do too.
Check out more of her expressions in the gallery.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/QrU1C0Z.png[/img]


[size=4]3/16/17: Uploaded with Refined [color=#a64d79]Maru[/color] Portraits[/size]
[size=2]I felt Maru was not as attractive as the other bachelorettes so I fixed her up a bit.
[/size]Her face was slimmed and the shading on the neck is more realistic. Her other expressions were also improved to look more young/feminine.
And ugh, I really hated her nurse hat.
[spoiler]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/xAq5HDR.png[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/NMMDoxX.png[/img]
[/spoiler]

[size=4]2/20/20: Updated [color=#a64d79]Maru[/color] Portraits[/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/nJa1G2w.png[/img]
This is an updated version of Maru's portrait with hair that looks better with her smaller face that I first changed.
Currently, only this Maru portrait mod is CP compatible. 

[size=4][b][u]Instructions:
[/u][/b][/size]. This mod replaces the original portrait .xnb files found in Content\Portraits. Please make a backup of the original files if necessary.
. Unzip or extract the files for the portraits you want to replace after downloading.
. Place (or replace) the file(s) into the Stardew Valley folder under Content\Portraits.

Thanks for downloading!

[size=3]Check out my [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/938/?]Refined Bachelors Portraits [/url]too![/size]
